source: i want to make a game where you can find people kinda like hide and game but the place is a big arcade

image_prompt.text: Dense repeating rows and clusters of arcade cabinets arranged to break sightlines for hiding
The aisles between cabinet banks read as a warren to hide and be hunted in
An open entrance area of the arcade where players gather before a round
the entire play space is the inside of one big arcade building

notes: Preset caveat: Childhood Game contributes a hide-and-seek maze, which an open arcade floor does not really support - it is kept and flagged as rejected, and it is the sole reason P6 appears in the route.
Nothing in this block records that the play space is an interior; only the no-genre axes can express enclosure.
